thread:
frank: Heads-up — noticed streaming docs for /v1/generate SSE events use "choices" in event payloads but runtime now emits "outputs" with nested "delta" objects. Example in docs: { "event": { "choice": { "text": "..." } } } is wrong and breaks our example parsers.

anita: ugh. That will break our code snippets that parse events incrementally. Which pages need edits?

frank: generate streaming guide + the SDK streaming examples (js/python) + the api-ref streaming example block. The JS sample does evt.data.choices[0].delta.text and will throw.

devx: propose: update all streaming examples to evt.data.outputs[0].delta and add a tiny compatibility snippet showing how to map legacy choices to outputs (one-liner). Also update the SSE example event JSON to be valid (no trailing commas).

sam: small nit — the JS example uses new EventSource(url) and then JSON.parse(e.data) without try/catch; if we change payload shape, show robust parsing: try { const p = JSON.parse(e.data) } catch (err) { return } . Add that to snippet-lint.

anita: also found a mismatch in function-call examples: docs show tool_call: { name, args } but SDK emits function_call: { name, arguments } (note singular vs plural). This makes the typed JS SDK example fail to compile.

frank: server uses function_call with arguments (stringified JSON). We should standardize docs to function_call.arguments and update the TypeScript snippet to parse JSON.parse(function_call.arguments).

devx: I'll open a PR that: 1) replaces choices with outputs in streaming examples, 2) updates SSE example JSON blocks, 3) fixes function_call naming in api-ref and js/types snippets, 4) runs ./scripts/snippet-lint and ./scripts/docs-build. Tagging @sam for the JS snippet review.

sam: thanks — please also grep examples/streaming and snippets/*stream* for choices and tool_call to be thorough. I'll review the JS changes.

docs-bot: Draft PR opened by devx: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

frank: timeline: small PR, aiming to merge today after a quick lint + 1 reviewer. :thumbsup:
